sam_sales: Hey team 2: Prospect (CoreLedger) asked for an air-gapped POC delivered via courier USB. Requirements: no telemetry, offline license activation using their HSM (FIPS cert), monthly signed release attestations. Need quick runbook + price delta.

nina_presec: Two signing models: (A) Redwood produces signed artifact and customer re-signs inside their HSM (preferred), (B) we perform final signing using their HSM (requires on-prem ops & legal). Recommend A to minimize liability.

diego_eng: Tech notes: we can produce "minibundles" and delta patches for app/runtime layers. If model quant or KV cache format changes, deltas are incompatible -> full image replace. Zero-telemetry build supported via build flag `--no-telemetry` (adds ~3 biz days).

rachel_ops: USB delivery specifics: we package as ZIP with `manifest.txt`, `sbom.json`, `signature.sig`, and a `verify.sh` helper. We'll include SHA256 sums and step-by-step verify instructions. USB burn + manual QA adds ~5 biz days.

sam_sales: Pricing? customer asked for estimate for POC + 3 monthly deltas.

nina_presec: Security addendum: we never keep customer private keys. We can supply signed attestations (PDF) with build hash, SBOM digest, and CI build snapshot.

diego_eng: Timeline rough: onboarding (2 biz days) -> packaging pipeline config (4 biz days) -> build + SBOM + test (7 biz days) -> USB prep (2 biz days) -> handoff. Total ~3-4 weeks if no quant changes.

rachel_ops: Recommend retention plan: customer keep previous full image snapshot for rollback. Deltas are one-way; we do not support automatic rollback across quant changes.

sam_sales: Ballpark pricing I'm proposing: one-time POC packaging + USB prep $12,500; SBOM & attestation pack $2,000; three monthly signed-deltas retainer $2,700 (total); emergency full-image hotfix support $4,500/event. Add clause: quantization-triggered full image builds billed separately.

legal-bot: notice: Any request to perform signing inside customer HSM requires legal review and an addendum to the master agreement.

nina_presec: I'll draft a short preflight checklist to send to CoreLedger: HSM cert fingerprint (PEM), courier details & chain-of-custody, confirmation of `--no-telemetry`, allowed maintenance window, acceptance test criteria (signature verify, cold-start, p99 latency), and whether they prefer Redwood-signed-only or want us to integrate with their HSM.

sam_sales: Perfect 2: Send checklist + the pricing sketch to the customer this afternoon. I'll loop in legal if they insist on HSM integration. Thanks everyone :rocket:
